## Purpose

Preserve the strategic proposition, drafting corrections and operational takeaways needed for future Israel-facing emails concerning a possible long-term relationship between Aweswell, Actyus and Andbank Group.

This is a continuity derivative only. The native emails, recipients, correspondence history, attachments, direct-message exchanges and exact private locators remain in the access-controlled mailbox or transaction workspace.

## Controlling objective

Do **not** frame the work as a request to sell one hotel, obtain one introduction, find another Spanish contact or ask somebody to do Gil Marer a favour.

The objective is to explore a durable, group-level commercial relationship in which:

- **Aweswell** is positioned as a UK hospitality sponsor/originator with a controlled pipeline of hospitality and real-asset opportunities;
- **Actyus** may evaluate hospitality investments and appropriate co-investment opportunities;
- **Andbank** may become a long-term private-banking, wealth-management, financing and corporate-finance relationship where mandate fit and future liquidity justify it; and
- the **Israel-side Andbank/Sigma ecosystem** may help develop a two-way commercial bridge involving suitable Israeli principals, family offices, investors or partners.

Sun Park / MYND Yaiza may be a starting point, existing reference or one transaction. It is not the whole proposition.

## Private-record position that may be paraphrased, not published verbatim

The private working record supports the following limited continuity:

- there is a live, structured dialogue with the Actyus hospitality channel concerning more than one Canary Islands opportunity, including a confidentiality process and genuine preliminary screening;
- there were substantive Andbank Luxembourg and Andbank Spain discussions in 2021–2022 spanning prospective hotel transactions, private banking, wealth management, financing structures and possible future liquidity events;
- an Israel/Sigma-linked route formed part of that historical relationship; and
- those historical discussions did **not** establish a completed account opening, financing, mandate, investment approval or transaction.

All historic valuation, LTV, credit, custody, product and transaction terms are exploratory and stale unless revalidated.

## Israel opportunity framing

The preferred framing is:

> A live Actyus hospitality dialogue has created an opportunity to develop a broader Israel–Andbank–Actyus–Aweswell business relationship. The right commercially minded person in Israel can help recognise, shape and sponsor that opportunity, connect it to the appropriate Israel-side network and convene the relevant senior group participants.

The Israel-side role should be capable of adding real commercial value, not merely forwarding a deck. Potential value can include, where appropriate and subject to all diligence and approvals:

- access to a recurring Spanish hospitality and real-assets opportunity pipeline;
- introductions to suitable Israeli investors, family offices, principals or co-investors;
- a bridge to Actyus and Andbank Group decision-makers;
- private-banking and wealth-management relationships around future realised liquidity; and
- financing, structuring or corporate-finance collaboration where mandate fit exists.

## Meeting objective

Seek an **in-person, senior, relevant meeting** that can establish whether a group-level relationship is worth structuring and identify who should own each workstream internally.

The senior route must complement, not undermine, the current Actyus hospitality channel. It is not an attempt to bypass:

- the existing hospitality contacts;
- confidentiality requirements;
- investment committees;
- compliance, conflicts or due diligence; or
- asset-specific title, control, condition-precedent, warranty, covenant and delivery analysis.

The purpose is to avoid organisational fragmentation, not governance.

## Future email drafting rules

### 1. Lead with the opportunity

Open with the live commercial opportunity and the wider relationship that may be built. Do not lead with:

- where Gil is located;
- a need for help;
- a request for another contact;
- litigation or the Por Derecho website; or
- a long history of the asset.

A useful opening proposition is:

> There is a real opportunity to build a broader business relationship between Aweswell, Actyus and Andbank Group, including a meaningful role for the Andbank/Sigma ecosystem in Israel.

### 2. Make the ask precise

Ask the recipient to identify or become **one genuinely connected, commercially active Israel-side sponsor** who can:

- understand the opportunity quickly;
- make a personal call;
- arrange the right senior meeting;
- connect the Israel-side relationship to Actyus and the group level; and
- remain engaged long enough to help shape a repeat relationship.

Quality and directness of relationship matter more than a list of names.

### 3. Hebrew-first for Israel-facing recipients

Where the recipient is Israeli and not comfortable with English:

- write in clear, natural Hebrew;
- use the Israeli form of the person's name;
- transliterate Andbank and Actyus into Hebrew where helpful;
- translate commercial concepts rather than stacking English jargon;
- begin with **"בשורה התחתונה"** when the recipient values directness; and
- keep the tone warm, friendly and practical.

A controlled Hebrew core message is:

> נפתחה כאן הזדמנות עסקית אמיתית לבנות מערכת יחסים רחבה בין Aweswell, אקטיוס וקבוצת אנדבנק, ובפרט לבחון כיצד הפעילות והקשרים של אנדבנק / סיגמא בישראל יכולים לקחת בה חלק. אני מחפש בישראל אדם עסקי, יוזם ומחובר, שיזהה את ההזדמנות, יפתח את הדלת הנכונה ויעזור לחבר בין הצד הישראלי, אקטיוס והדרג הבכיר בקבוצה.

Do not preserve recipient-specific greetings, holidays, family references or private relationship details in Git. They may be used transiently in the actual email only when current, appropriate and directly sourced.

### 4. Respect what the recipient already knows

Do not repeat obvious personal facts merely to establish geography or history. State only what advances the commercial proposition.

For a recipient known to dislike long documents:

- put the bottom line first;
- use short sections and descriptive headings;
- make one clear request;
- include a forwardable block; and
- let the visual carry part of the explanation.

### 5. Make the email easy to forward

Include a self-contained section suitable for a commercially driven person who does not know Gil or Aweswell. It should explain:

1. who Aweswell is;
2. what live Actyus engagement exists at a high level;
3. why this is broader than one asset;
4. what value may exist for the Israel-side Andbank/Sigma ecosystem; and
5. the exact action requested: a personal senior introduction and meeting.

The forwarded section must not contain private-source detail, personal history, unannounced pricing, recipient data or a claim of completed approval.

### 6. Use visuals accurately

A Canary Islands platform visual may accompany the email, but it must distinguish:

- the real current reference: Sun Park operating as MYND Yaiza; and
- illustrative geography or project-type panels for Tenerife, wider Lanzarote and Las Palmas / Gran Canaria.

Never imply that illustrative buildings are owned, controlled, mandated or available through Aweswell unless that proposition is independently verified and authorised for disclosure.

### 7. Keep the public dispute record separate

Do not make the Por Derecho litigation/accountability website the opening pitch. The first communication should be commercial, confidential and opportunity-led.

Legal, recovery, ownership, control and dispute matters must be disclosed fully and proportionately when relevant to asset-level diligence, under the correct confidentiality and transaction perimeter.

## Wording to avoid

Avoid formulations equivalent to:

- "I am in Spain and need somebody in Israel to help me";
- "find me a contact at Andbank";
- "I have a hotel to sell";
- "we need to bypass the people in Spain";
- "Andbank already approved / financed / onboarded us"; or
- "the other illustrated projects are ours".

Use instead:

> A live hospitality dialogue creates an opportunity for a broader group relationship. We are looking for the right Israel-side commercial sponsor to recognise that opportunity, open the correct senior door and help connect the relevant participants.
